truthBoundary: Live web-search observations are evidence of web surfacing/citations, not verified organic rank, and a 0% citation rate is only meaningful for queries the provider actually answered. GSC average position is the authoritative Google-owned performance metric available to this system.

lastStop.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED
lastStop.reason: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is not set, so no live query observation was attempted. No citation rate was recorded.

openrouter_web_search.costBoundary: Paid per request on OpenRouter; the workflow enforces a bounded daily query panel via LIVE_QUERY_LIMIT.
